findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "invoices" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoices_list, invoices_send, invoices_save_repeating, invoices_report, account_set_owner_email, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: invoices_connect_stripe, invoices_get_profile, invoices_create, invoices_update, invoices_get, invoices_send, invoices_convert_quote, invoices_record_payment, invoices_record_prepayment, invoices_use_credit, invoices_create_credit_note, invoices_void, invoices_statement, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: invoices_connect_stripe, invoices_set_profile, invoices_create, invoices_get, invoices_send, invoices_convert_quote, invoices_use_credit, invoices_create_credit_note, invoices_remind, invoices_remind_overdue, invoices_save_repeating, invoices_statement, account_set_owner_email, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: invoices_delete_repeating, account_balance, account_add_approval_rule.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
